name: fatfish-watermark
description: Replace electerm's default terminal watermark with a pixel-art 大肥鱼 (DeepSeek whale-girl).
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: Fatfish Terminal Watermark
electerm.description: Replace the default electerm watermark with a pixel-art 大肥鱼 / DeepSeek whale-girl. Colour pixel art or a theme-colour mask that adapts to any background.

configs.name: style
configs.label: Artwork style
configs.description: Colour pixel art is cuter and visible on light/dark/coloured themes; the theme-colour mask paints the same pixels with --text for strict theme matching.

configs.name: opacity
configs.label: Opacity (%)
configs.description: How strong the watermark is, in percent. Clamped to 5–60. The colour style is drawn a little stronger (1.4x) than the mask style.

configs.name: size
configs.label: Height (%)
configs.description: Watermark height as a percent of the terminal pane. Clamped to 30–95; the width follows the artwork's aspect ratio.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.
